INTENDED SELL FEES

Total stays 4%

0.1% liquidity + 3.9% receiver

0.1%Liquidity
3.9%Fixed receiver

The receiver allocates 75% to its immutable payout wallet and 25% to the ZYPTO buy-and-burn budget: 2.925% and 0.975% of a taxable sell respectively. Token output depends on price and AMM fees.

Buy fee rates are preserved. Changing the marketing receiver affects both buy and sell marketing payouts, including pending payouts. None of these setup calls transfers ETH to the token contract; only network gas is paid.

DEPLOYED RECEIVER

Verification required

Fixed application configuration

Immutable 75% payout destination0x7fFa6CBe2516B0c15966f0DA27261ffd0d9a8651

The receiver's executable bytecode and immutable destinations were independently checked. The app verifies the pinned live code and destinations before every setup step. This is not a security audit.

Buybacks use a spot quote and slippage limit; they are not MEV-proof. Direct WETH transfers require a later processing trigger. This setup does not send WETH, approve spending or call processing.

Complete only the necessary steps

Already satisfied settings are skipped. Review and confirm each remaining transaction separately; the app never submits a batch.

  1. 1. Make the receiver fee-exempt

    excludeFromFees(fixedReceiver, true)

    Required by the receiver's buyback code even when the token's buy fee is 0%. This is a token fee exemption, not a spending approval.

    Not checked

  2. 2. Set the intended sell fees

    setSellFee(10, 390)

    10 basis points for liquidity and 390 for the receiver; total 400 basis points (4%). Buy fee rates stay unchanged.

    Not checked

  3. 3. Set the marketing receiver

    setMarketingWallet(fixedReceiver)

    Uses the verified address above automatically, after exemption and sell fees are confirmed.

    Not checked
